core: Both communities run a deliberate mid-task intervention on an agent's retained scratchpad/notes — wiping them clean or swapping in a degraded rewrite — at a specific checkpoint before the final synthesis/output stage, in order to isolate how much of the agent's downstream performance or recovery ability comes from the accumulated intermediate notes themselves versus the underlying model's raw capability.
quote_1: We wiped the scratchpad right after the injected 503 to see if it could recover the plan from context alone, and it couldn't — it just retried the same broken call five times.
quote_2: ⟦T2⟧ replaced the retained repair plan after the corrupted row had been encountered but before final export.
